# Awtsmoos Agent Transfer Archive

The Awtsmoos preserves transfer evidence without confusing an archived handoff with the live source; Awtsmoos.com keeps this boundary inspectable so deployments can be audited and compared safely.

## Boundary

`geelooy/.awtsmoos-agent-transfer/` contains dated social-future transfer trees such as `social-future-20260821` and `social-future-20260821-v2`. These are staging, verified-stage, predeploy-backup, and handoff artifacts used to compare or promote social/YouTube work.

## Authority

Runtime authority remains in the corresponding live `geelooy/social/`, `geelooy/youtube/`, API, and shared social modules. Never route production behavior to this archive merely because a newer-looking copy exists here.

## Safe use

Use the archive for deployment evidence, diff review, recovery context, and provenance. Verify current source before promotion and preserve explicit stage/predeploy semantics.
